video_title: OG Or Brunson? The Crew CAN'T Agree On Finals MVP

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues OG Anunoby is the Knicks' Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: It is OG Anunoby and it is not even close.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: If I asked you the question now, who is the Finals MVP in this series if it ended today?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: That is the easiest, there is only one answer. It is OG Anunoby and it is not even close.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson evaluates Jalen Brunson's efficiency in the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson was the least efficient guy on their team in the first three games.
quotes.quote: If you were to say the first three games, you probably would have said Carl Anthony Towns. Jalen Brunson was the least efficient guy on their team in the first three games. If you are just playing the game, Jalen Brunson, who had probably performed at the highest level? After the first two or three games, it was KAT.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains why Jalen Brunson faces defensive pressure
quotes.excerpt: Why was OG open for that tip? Because they double team Brunson.
quotes.quote: The pressure of being the initiator and the primary scorer and ball handler and creating shots and having teams double team you, why was OG open for that tip? Because they double team Brunson. It is not always the star in the role, it is not always the most efficient, it is maximizing the opportunities that are being presented to you because you are a star player. Just like you said, when Kyrie and LeBron, y'all get to play one-on-one. Brunson is not getting to play one-on-one.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins names Jalen Brunson as his Finals MVP pick
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson has been the best player consistently in my opinion throughout these playoffs.
quotes.quote: I get it, OG Anunoby had big time moments. But Jalen Brunson has been the best player consistently in my opinion throughout these playoffs. I know the shooting splits are not going to say this, but in the fourth quarter, when it is time for him to take over, game one, game two, game three, we got to pump the brakes on trying to annoy other people over what this man has done.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins recalls recruiting Jalen Brunson to Villanova
quotes.excerpt: He never makes excuses, he never throws anyone under the bus, he just keeps on moving.
quotes.quote: He never makes excuses, he never throws anyone under the bus, he just keeps on moving. When you talk about one of the bright young stars, we might could call him a superstar at this point. He never makes excuses, he never throws anyone under the bus, he just keeps on moving.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins recounts Alvin Gentry's coaching style with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Gentry ran his ass to the fan and said shut the hell up.
quotes.quote: When I was with the Pelicans, Coach Alvin Gentry, we were playing LeBron, the Cavs, we were playing y'all, Allie, Richard, Channing. It was a close game in the fourth quarter, LeBron started, a fan started talking shit to Bron. Gentry ran his ass to the fan and said shut the hell up. He said because you are not the one that has to guard this man in between the lines.
